src/mindspace_graph/api.py.responsibility: Creates the FastAPI application, wires shared services and delegates route registration to the split api_routes modules.

src/mindspace_graph/api_routes/context.p.responsibility: Defines request DTOs, shared response normalizers and the ApiContext dependency bundle consumed by every route registrar.

src/mindspace_graph/api_routes/chat_runs.responsibility: Registers synchronous chat, streaming chat, durable run event replay, cancellation and interruption endpoints.

src/mindspace_graph/api_routes/character.responsibility: Registers character library, V2 card, avatar, session and profile compatibility endpoints.

src/mindspace_graph/api_routes/destiny_r.responsibility: Registers V7 journey, avatar, archetype, 6+6 card batch, selection, synthesis and commit endpoints.

src/mindspace_graph/api_routes/system_se.responsibility: Registers product settings, provider connection tests, model discovery and public configuration endpoints.

src/mindspace_graph/api_routes/memory_kn.responsibility: Registers memory, knowledge, entity and retrieval maintenance endpoints against the shared API context.

src/mindspace_graph/api_routes/audio_sce.responsibility: Registers ASR, TTS, voice catalog, scene, journal and presentation-facing endpoints.

src/mindspace_graph/api_routes/legacy_ro.responsibility: Keeps explicit legacy and 410 route contracts isolated from current product route modules.

src/mindspace_graph/conversation_runs.py.responsibility: Persists durable conversation runs and ordered SSE envelopes, supports replay, join, completion and orphan recovery.

src/mindspace_graph/service.py.responsibility: Coordinates a conversation turn across profiles, retrieval, LangGraph execution, persistence, compaction and post-turn work.

src/mindspace_graph/graph.py.responsibility: Builds the single-turn LangGraph and its conditional native-tool execution path.

src/mindspace_graph/destiny.py.responsibility: Owns V7 journey state, two half-card batches, tolerant card parsing, selections, V2 synthesis and commit.

src/mindspace_graph/adapters/openai_comp.responsibility: Implements OpenAI-compatible streaming, structured output compatibility ladders, native tool calls and provider attempt diagnostics.

src/mindspace_graph/native_tools.py.responsibility: Defines the compact native tool schemas, provider eligibility and validated host-call conversion.

frontend/src/api.ts.responsibility: Provides the typed API/SSE client, durable run stream access and desktop-settings transport switch.

frontend/src/chat/useConversation.ts.responsibility: Owns chat request submission, durable run recovery, SSE event reduction and message state transitions.

frontend/src/chat/Composer.tsx.responsibility: Renders the composer, attachments, model switch, ASR/send action and multi-select interaction tags.

frontend/src/chat/ExecutionInspector.tsx.responsibility: Renders persisted RAG, provider and tool attempts without inventing cards for null executions.

frontend/src/settings/SettingsWorkspace..responsibility: Presents provider, model, appearance, voice and storage settings through the controlled settings bridge.

frontend/src/characters/CharacterExperie.responsibility: Presents mode lobby, character picker/library and navigation into V7 creation or local chat.

desktop/main.cjs.responsibility: Composes Electron lifecycle, windows, preload security, service supervision, settings and update controllers.

desktop/preload.cjs.responsibility: Exposes the narrow renderer IPC bridge for settings, updates, diagnostics, storage and window operations.

desktop/settings-controller.cjs.responsibility: Coordinates Core-first settings writes with encrypted provider secret persistence and rollback-safe status reporting.

desktop/update-controller.cjs.responsibility: Coordinates signed Core and Launcher update checks, progress, installation and recovery policies.

desktop/service-supervisor.cjs.responsibility: Starts, observes and boundedly restarts Core and optional voice services using the shared port registry.

scripts/generate-codebase-index.mjs.responsibility: Builds architecture and per-file indexes from the explicit maintained-file set and fails check mode on coverage drift.

scripts/verify-repository-policy.mjs.responsibility: Enforces dependency, secret, source-map, documentation, release allowlist, bootstrap and index-completeness policy.

scripts/verify-current-doc-paths.mjs.responsibility: Checks path-like references in current authority documents and fails when a maintained target moved or disappeared.

config/version.json.responsibility: Canonical product and signed-runtime version contract consumed by synchronization and verification tools.

config/core-release-allowlist.json.responsibility: Positive allowlist for Core update source trees and explicit runtime files.
